## Setup (n8n 2.39.6+)
1. Configure tenant ID below.
2. Create generic OAuth2 credentials with offline_access accounting.contacts.read accounting.invoices.read. Assign to both Xero HTTP nodes. Do not use the built-in Xero credential (it requests write scopes).
3. Optional: assign OpenAI header credential, enable its HTTP node and enable PDFs.
4. Publish the form. Operator must sign in to n8n.
5. Review README retention settings before real data.
No data is posted to Xero; no emails are sent.

parameters.formDescription: Upload a UTF-8 CSV or text-based PDF. One organization, supplier and currency per run. PDFs use optional OpenAI extraction and require your confirmation.
